stories.title: Giants acquire QB McCarthy from Vikings for 2027 draft pick
stories.summary: The Giants are trading for Vikings quarterback J.J. McCarthy, sending a 2027 fifth-round draft pick to Minnesota for the 2024 first-round pick.

stories.title: LeBron envisioned joining Knicks but nixed idea after historic title
stories.summary: LeBron James told ESPN that he envisioned joining the Knicks as a free agent this summer but nixed the idea after New York won the NBA title.

stories.title: Sources: Dolphins' Achane tore ACL, to miss rest of season
stories.summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a torn ACL during Sunday's loss to the Chiefs and will be out for the rest of the 2026 season, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.
